The reference and outcome time points do not overlap, so the opposite directions (+ regain vs - loss) are not competing answers to the same question but descriptions of different post-surgical intervals. There is no common comparable contrast, so the pair is unfit for agreement/contradiction comparison; the decisive obstacle is the differing, non-overlapping time windows of the within-group weight changes.
